subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are synchronized and exact-head checks pass, does `openclaw/openclaw-secops` approve the updated executable action revisions for the secret-bearing and security-scanning workflows?
rationale: Verified upstream commits reduce supply-chain uncertainty, but approval of executable dependency changes in token-bearing security workflows is an explicit repository ownership decision.

options.title: Approve repaired exact head
options.body: Review the verified revisions after the guard repair and approve only if the focused security and workflow checks pass on that same SHA.

options.title: Pause the grouped refresh
options.body: Keep the batch unmerged if the privileged revisions cannot be reviewed together with their enforcement updates.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired exact head
recommendation.body: Review the verified revisions after the guard repair and approve only if the focused security and workflow checks pass on that same SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the central CodeQL and Dependency Guard surfaces to this security-review group.
